SELECT users.id, users.telegram_user_id, users.username, users.first_name, users.language_code, users.timezone, users.referral_code, users.referred_by_user_id, users.status, users.created_at, users.last_seen_at, users.referral_prompt_shown_
SELECT coalesce(max(streak_state.best_streak), $1::INTEGER) AS coalesce_1 FROM streak_state

SELECT entitlements.id, entitlements.user_id, entitlements.entitlement_type, entitlements.scope, entitlements.status, entitlements.starts_at, entitlements.ends_at, entitlements.source_purchase_id, entitlements.idempotency_key, entitlements.
UPDATE users SET last_seen_at=$1::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE WHERE users.id = $2::BIGINT

SELECT quiz_attempts.question_id FROM quiz_attempts JOIN quiz_sessions ON quiz_attempts.session_id = quiz_sessions.id WHERE quiz_attempts.user_id = $1::BIGINT AND quiz_sessions.mode_code = $2::VARCHAR ORDER BY quiz_attempts.answered_at DESC

SELECT quiz_questions.question_id AS quiz_questions_question_id, quiz_questions.mode_code AS quiz_questions_mode_code, quiz_questions.source_file AS quiz_questions_source_file, quiz_questions.level AS quiz_questions_level, quiz_questions.ca

SELECT energy_state.user_id, energy_state.free_energy, energy_state.paid_energy, energy_state.free_cap, energy_state.regen_interval_sec, energy_state.last_regen_at, energy_state.last_daily_topup_local_date, energy_state.version, energy_stat

INSERT INTO quiz_sessions (id, user_id, mode_code, source, status, energy_cost_total, question_id, daily_run_id, friend_challenge_id, friend_challenge_round, arena_attempt_id, arena_round, started_at, completed_at, local_date_berlin, idempo

SELECT tournament_participants.joined_at FROM tournament_participants JOIN tournaments ON tournaments.id = tournament_participants.tournament_id WHERE tournament_participants.user_id = $1::BIGINT AND tournaments.type = $2::VARCHAR AND tourn
